description: This file defines the interface for the Manufacturer WiFi API, including function prototypes for initializing, deinitializing, getting, setting, and erasing WiFi credentials. It primarily contains function declarations and documentation comments, with no implementation details.

methods.name: WIFI_Init
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi data subsystem and associated data structures.

methods.name: WIFI_DeInit
methods.description: Terminates the WiFi data subsystem, releasing associated resources.

methods.name: WIFI_GetCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi credentials into the provided data structure.

methods.name: WIFI_SetCredentials
methods.description: Sets WiFi credentials from the provided data structure.
